title: Sentinel-2 L2A true-colour RGB COGs (valid-data footprints), 2019
description: Sentinel-2 L2A true-colour composites for 2019: 8-bit 3-band cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs in EPSG:3857 with internal overviews and an internal mask band. Identical raster files to sentinel-2-l2a-rgb-cog-masked-2019; the only difference is that each item's geometry is the REAL valid-data footprint derived from the mask, rather than the raster's bounding rectangle. That matters because pgstac's mosaic shortcuts (skipcovered / exitwhenfull) compare geometries: with bounding rectangles, all scenes of a tile look identical and pgstac stops after the first, so a partial granule leaves holes. Render with assets=visual, no rescale and NO nodata parameter. Pixel values are contrast-stretched for display and are NOT reflectance.

visual.title: True-colour RGB (8-bit COG, EPSG:3857, internal mask)
